description: Unlock the full breadth of Wind financial data and tools, covering equities, funds, bonds, commodities, indices, and economic data across more than 60 countries and regions worldwide, including Mainland China, Hong Kong, and the United States, as well as Wind financial models and toolsets. Turn WorkBuddy into a financial analysis expert—a professional agent with multidimensional capabilities in data drill-down, investment research and analysis, risk-informed decision-making, and more.

examples_en: How have NVIDIA's revenue, net income, and ROE changed over the past three years?
